visual_name: Day in the life, part forty seven: the knot (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js yoga studio in the morning (light oak floor, four big windows, a mirror wall, potted plants, a rack of rolled mats and blocks, a shelf with candles and a singing bowl, four mats and a cushion), box-built yoga teacher with a high bun, a lilac top and grey leggings, three box-built students for the class, phone sheets for her sent pitch / the follow-up thread (just bumping this, bumping again, per my last email, hello?, a breathing voice note) / the brand's 'Who is this?' / YourBrand Brand Pitch Templates (Cold pitch, Warm follow-up, Personalise with AI, brand, niche and deliverable typed, Subject, Email, DM version, Follow-up (4 days later)), hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 43.4 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a yoga teacher pitches a mat brand on Monday, hears nothing, and follows up: just bumping this, bumping again, per my last email, hello?, then a voice note of herself breathing. The brand replies: who is this? She tries her hardest pose and gets stuck in it. Then YourBrand: Brand Pitch Templates, Personalise with AI, brand, niche and deliverable in; one email, one DM and one follow-up, four days later, not four hours. She teaches the knot now. Nobody gets out.
